item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The CPB Board and agency heads are mandatorily directed to cancel existing funding, deny future funding, and revise grant terms to prohibit NPR/PBS funding; the legal consequences occur through those later administrative and grant actions.","evidence":"The CPB Board shall cancel existing direct funding to the maximum extent allowed by law and shall decline to provide future funding."},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"The CPB Board must take further administrative steps whose specified result is minimizing or eliminating indirect federal funding of NPR and PBS.","evidence":"the CPB Board shall take all other necessary steps to minimize or eliminate its indirect funding of NPR and PBS"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"All agency heads must identify and later terminate direct or indirect funding of NPR and PBS, producing a dictated funding consequence through agency action.","evidence":"The heads of all agencies shall identify and terminate, to the maximum extent consistent with applicable law, any direct or indirect funding of NPR and PBS."},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads are directed to identify remaining grants and contracts after completing the preceding actions; this is an internal administrative review without a specified legal consequence in this segment.","evidence":"the heads of all agencies shall identify any remaining grants, contracts"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads must determine whether NPR and PBS comply with remaining funding instruments; the segment requires a compliance review but does not dictate its outcome or a resulting sanction.","evidence":"shall determine whether NPR and PBS are in compliance with the terms of those instruments"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"If noncompliance is found, the relevant agency head must take unspecified appropriate steps under the instrument, leaving the particular consequence to later administration.","evidence":"shall take appropriate steps under the terms of the instrument"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of Health and Human Services must conduct a compliance determination concerning NPR and PBS; this segment does not dictate the finding or itself impose a consequence.","evidence":"The Secretary of Health and Human Services shall determine whether"},{"segment_id":"8","code":0,"rationale":"This segment is only the continuation of a quotation describing the statutory nondiscrimination standard; it independently directs no presidential governance action and creates no new legal consequence.","evidence":"shall be subjected to discrimination in employment . . . on the grounds of race, color, religion, national origin, or sex."},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must take unspecified corrective action following a noncompliance finding, while the remaining severability and general provisions preserve existing authority and constrain implementation rather than themselves changing substantive legal rights.","evidence":"the Secretary of Health and Human Services shall take appropriate corrective action"}]}
